payload.body: Client call helpers shipped across all 3 platforms over the call wire protocol (CallCommand=21/CallCommandResult=22, Nack-by-requestId): TS core createCall/joinCall/acceptCall/leaveCall/endCall/setCallMediaState + observable callState + react useCallState/useCallActions; Swift FrickSyncSocket helpers + @Observable FrickCallSession; Android FrickCallManager suspend verbs + StateFlow<CallState>.
